build_detr_backbone: build a DETR backbone with ResNet, FBNet, or simple single stage and position encoding from config
build_detr_model: build a DETR model instance by name from the DETR_MODEL_REGISTRY using a config object
create_ResNetMaskedBackbone: create a ResNetMaskedBackbone that wraps Detectron2 backbone with padding masking for NestedTensor inputs
create_FBNetMaskedBackbone: create an FBNetMaskedBackbone that wraps Detectron2 FBNet backbone with padding masking and feature strides
create_SimpleSingleStageBackbone: create a SimpleSingleStageBackbone with configurable stride and channel for single stage feature extraction
